Fake ACB Officer Robs Home Under Threat of Gun

Two incidents involved individuals posing as Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) officers to commit robberies. In one case, a fake ACB officer entered a home, threatened the occupants with a gun, and stole 8 mobile phones and other items worth ₹2.5 lakh. The accused in this incident has been arrested. In another report, an accused who entered a home posing as an ACB officer, threatened to shoot, and stole valuables worth lakhs, is absconding.
